core_obligations: Choose an injective resolution (proof lines 14092-14093): resolve F by injectives on X_etale, so that the derived functors are computed by the resulting complex.

Produce the short exact sequence of complexes (proof lines 14094-14099): by the discussion preceding the lemma, 0 -> i_*H_Z(I^bullet) -> I^bullet -> j_*(I^bullet|_U) -> 0 is a short exact sequence of complexes of abelian sheaves on X_etale.

Extract the consequences (proof lines 14100-14101): a short exact sequence of complexes gives a distinguished triangle in D(X_etale), whose long exact cohomology sequence is the displayed exact sequence and whose higher terms are the displayed isomorphisms.
proof_roadmap: Resolve F injectively so that R j_* and R H_Z are computed by the resolution.
Use the preceding discussion to get the short exact sequence of complexes cutting out the support.
Convert that short exact sequence into a distinguished triangle in the derived category.
Read off the displayed exact sequence and the isomorphisms for p at least 1.
difficulty_reason: The lemma packages the local cohomology of a closed immersion: for i : Z -> X a closed immersion with open complement j : U -> X there is a distinguished triangle i_*R H_Z(F) -> F -> Rj_*(F|_U) -> i_*R H_Z(F)[1], which yields the displayed exact sequence and the isomorphisms R^p j_*(F|_U) = i_* H^{p+1}_Z(F) for p at least 1 (statement lines 14071-14089). The proof is a short reduction: an injective resolution turns the sequence relating the sheaf, its sections supported in Z and its restriction to U into a short exact sequence of complexes (proof lines 14092-14099), and the standard mechanism attaching a distinguished triangle to such a sequence produces the triangle and hence the stated consequences (proof lines 14100-14101). The content is the correct assembly of these pieces. The claim is H2: one reduction from a short exact sequence of complexes to the derived statement.
